findings.title: CR3-AC-66 lacks its FEAT-007 part; CR3-AC-66, MDL-3 and CR3-IH-4 are in no later item's Rows
findings.detail: CR3-AC-66's evidence ends '... are FEAT-007/009' with no FEAT-007 part, although TurnStore.done stores chat_turns.answer_text redacted (test_turns.py::test_stored_answer_is_redacted_and_bounded, test_backend.py::test_ask_stores_the_redacted_answer). CR3-AC-66 and MDL-3 (phase names FEAT-009) and CR3-IH-4 (phase names FEAT-010) appear in no FEAT-009/010 item's Rows list in phase2-build-plan.md or the FEAT JSON; the phase-based matrix check at those close-outs still lists them, so nothing is lost. Fix (Phase 2 gate): record the FEAT-007 part on CR3-AC-66 and add the three ids to the Rows of items 47/49 (or close-out items 48/53).
